Layer: Semantic measure; Gold stores additive numerator and denominator
Formula: SUM(score) / SUM(points_possible) across rows where is_graded AND is_latest_attempt
Missingness: No graded latest attempt in the selection means unavailable, not zero. Unmarked work is excluded from both operands rather than scored zero, and a missing score is never read as a failure. Always read alongside graded_work_coverage so the ratio is not taken without its base.
FilterRules: Ratio of sums, never an average of per-task percentages: sum points earned and points possible separately, then divide. Filter is_latest_attempt on both operands so a resubmission is not counted twice. Preserve date-qualified school/class/teacher membership and authorization. Do not present subjects with different mark schemes as one comparable scale, and do not read the result as ability, growth or a prediction.

FilterRules: Count attempts once by filtering is_latest_attempt on both operands. Preserve date-qualified school/class/teacher membership and authorization. Never present coursework_score_ratio without this coverage beside it, because a high ratio over a small marked share is not a high achievement.
